scenarios.name: Complete both tracks
scenarios.expectedBehavior: After explicit reviewer confirmation, produce the three exact completedDocument strings, four actions and four draftStatusUpdate strings, and all 16 filingManifest entries from the referenced expected objects. Validate no remaining issues; queue offline. Exchange only after hold is lifted; one receipt and one filed packet. Never claim remote delivery.

scenarios.name: Replay and arbitrary delivery order
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Nine unique operations, two conflicts before merge, identical head sets for forward/reverse/shuffled order. Retain dangling-parent operations pending parent arrival; do not discard them. Explicit merges yield exactly canonicalRecordsAfterMerge and retain all 11 revisions.

scenarios.name: Interrupted bounded transfer
scenarios.expectedBehavior: First budget 300 sends critical bytes 0..99 and scan bytes 400..599; resume from acknowledged 600 sends scan 600..899; 100 scan bytes remain. Preserve actual acknowledged bytes across restart and check final SHA-256 on completion.

scenarios.name: Exact boundary and zero budget
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Budget 0 allocates 0 bytes and keeps offset 900. Budget 100 allocates exactly 100 bytes, next offset 1000, complete; no bytes exceed budget.

scenarios.name: Blank required field
scenarios.expectedBehavior: ITEM_REQUIRED: Enter an item. Preserve original source, entered values, pending queue and audit history; block affected submission. Set item to DEMO-FILTER; quantity 2 and other fields retained; validation passes.

scenarios.name: Invalid quantity
scenarios.expectedBehavior: QUANTITY_POSITIVE_INTEGER: Quantity must be a positive whole number. Preserve original source, entered values, pending queue and audit history; block affected submission. Set quantity to 2; completed document equals SUPPLY-001 expected completedDocument.

scenarios.name: Missing enclosure
scenarios.expectedBehavior: ENCLOSURE_MISSING: Attach referenced enclosure ENC-001. Preserve original source, entered values, pending queue and audit history; block affected submission. Attach exact recoveryEnclosure; correspondence validates and letter plus enclosure export matches expected.

scenarios.name: Ambiguous handwriting
scenarios.expectedBehavior: UNCERTAIN_TRANSCRIPTION: Confirm duration from the image: final digit is overwritten. Preserve original source, entered values, pending queue and audit history; block affected submission. Reviewer confirms 45; retain draft and image evidence; completed training log matches expected.

scenarios.name: Conflicting task dates
scenarios.expectedBehavior: DUE_DATE_CONFLICT: Choose 14:00Z or 17:00Z on 2026-11-06. Preserve original source, entered values, pending queue and audit history; block affected submission. Preserve both instructions; explicitly accept MAIL-010 decision; due becomes 2026-11-06T17:00:00Z, action verifies.

scenarios.name: Ambiguous task owner
scenarios.expectedBehavior: OWNER_AMBIGUOUS: Choose ADMIN-DEMO or TRAINING-DEMO. Preserve original source, entered values, pending queue and audit history; block affected submission. Explicitly accept MAIL-010 decision assigning ADMIN-DEMO; preserve all source evidence; action verifies.

scenarios.name: Malformed import
scenarios.expectedBehavior: IMPORT_JSON_INVALID: Import is not valid JSON. Preserve original source, entered values, pending queue and audit history; block affected submission. Keep existing packet and unsaved draft byte-for-byte; import the valid synthetic artifact, then resume review with no duplicate IDs.

scenarios.name: Unknown filing category
scenarios.expectedBehavior: FILING_CATEGORY_UNKNOWN: Choose an invented schedule category. Preserve original source, entered values, pending queue and audit history; block affected submission. Preserve record in holding state; reviewer selects SUPPLY; file to DEMO/Supply/2026 citing SCH-DEMO-1.

scenarios.name: Pending review route attempt
scenarios.expectedBehavior: REVIEW_REQUIRED: Approve the current packet revision before routing. Preserve original source, entered values, pending queue and audit history; block affected submission. Preserve packet with no inbox entry; reviewer approves exact current revision set, queue and exchange once.

scenarios.name: Stale approval
scenarios.expectedBehavior: APPROVAL_STALE: Packet changed; review again. Preserve original source, entered values, pending queue and audit history; block affected submission. Preserve both approval history and edits; reapprove current revision set; route exactly once.

scenarios.name: Storage failure
scenarios.expectedBehavior: STORAGE_WRITE_FAILED: Draft not saved; export or retry. Preserve original source, entered values, pending queue and audit history; block affected submission. Preserve unsavedNote in memory; do not acknowledge saved. Export retains note; free capacity and retry, then reload confirms note persisted.

scenarios.name: Invalid transfer offset
scenarios.expectedBehavior: OFFSET_INVALID: Offset must be a whole number from 0 to total bytes. Preserve original source, entered values, pending queue and audit history; block affected submission. Allocate nothing and preserve stored offset 400; correct import to offset 400; standalone budget 300 reaches 700.

scenarios.name: Negative transfer offset
scenarios.expectedBehavior: OFFSET_INVALID: Offset must be a whole number from 0 to total bytes. Preserve original source, entered values, pending queue and audit history; block affected submission. Preserve stored transfer and packet; correct to 400, retry with 300, next offset 700.

scenarios.name: EMCON hold on reconnect
scenarios.expectedBehavior: EMCON_HOLD: Exchange paused by operator. Preserve original source, entered values, pending queue and audit history; block affected submission. Keep durable queued packet unchanged and send zero bytes; explicitly lift hold, confirm current approval and exchange once.

scenarios.name: Cancel exchange
scenarios.expectedBehavior: TRANSFER_CANCELLED: Exchange stopped; acknowledged progress retained. Preserve original source, entered values, pending queue and audit history; block affected submission. Keep draft, queue and offset 600; explicit resume with budget 300 reaches 900; no background transfer while cancelled.

scenarios.name: Offline restart
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reload restores corrected documents, image, four verified actions, approval bound to current revisions and queued_offline state. No receipt exists before exchange. Permitted reconnect creates RECEIPT-001 exactly once.

scenarios.name: Duplicate receipt
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Inbox count remains 1; preserve original receipt receivedAt and filing entry; optional duplicate-attempt audit event must not duplicate routing side effects.

scenarios.name: Complete transfer already acknowledged
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Allocate zero bytes, keep offset 1000 and complete state; do not restart upload.

scenarios.name: Fictional time and errors
scenarios.expectedBehavior: 720 - 300 = 420 seconds = 7 minutes per packet; 6 * 420 / 3600 = 0.7 hours. Three seeded validation issues caught out of three = 100%; fictional rework 2 - 0 = 2 packets. Display synthetic provenance, real baseline unavailable and actual impact unverified.

limitations: All records, role identifiers, pen strokes, addresses, quantities, timings and rules are fictional. No operational sources were contacted.
Invented stand-ins, not DD 1348-1A/NAVPERS replicas or SECNAV M-5216.5 validated formats. No official blank forms or retention schedules supplied.
Training image is an original SVG pen-stroke facsimile, not an actual scanned handwritten document. Manual review, not OCR, is the declared transcription mechanism.

Fixture answer keys establish synthetic expectations only; application persistence, reconciliation, encryption, transport, government devices and low-code compatibility require separate implementation and verification.
All demo times are invented, not observed application measurements or an SME baseline. No real hours returned, error reductions, panel judgment or official score are asserted.
Synthetic local receiving inbox only; no cloud/government endpoint, real submission, disposal, pilot, deployment or owner approval.
UTC dates and deterministic ordering are fixture conventions, not authoritative routing or records policy. Role-only .invalid addresses contain no personal information.
The host must validate and freeze these artifacts before downstream use. Owner confirmation of actual forms, rules, routing, schedules, timing baseline and pilot authority remains outstanding.
